messages:
ravi: Quick bench focused on embeddings quantization (ember-8b). Compared fp16 vs int8 on retrieval + rerank pipeline across 3k eval pairs (en/es/zh + code-like keys). Dropping a short GTN/product playbook. Link: https://internal.redwood/bench/5210

sophie: TL;DR pls for product — is int8 safe for production retrieval?

ravi: TL;DR: int8 is OK for approximate retrieval (first-pass ANN) to save cost, BUT keep fp16 for embeddings used in rerank or semantic-match where precision matters. See compact numbers below.

lee: Paste the short scorecard we can show product.

ravi: Scorecard (3k pairs):
```
metric             | fp16   | int8   | delta
avg cosine          | 0.912  | 0.898  | -0.014
R@10 overall        | 0.821  | 0.804  | -1.7pp
R@10 (zh)           | 0.782  | 0.745  | -3.7pp
R@10 (code-keys)    | 0.744  | 0.702  | -4.2pp
latency p50 (ms)    | 118    | 126    | +8ms
cost / 1k emb tok   | $0.60  | $0.42  | -30%
```
Notes: biggest regressions on zh and code-like identifiers. Reranker downstream amplifies small cosine deltas into larger rank shifts for low-frequency tokens.

ara: Routing recs for GTN/product? one-liner please.

ravi: Suggested defaults:
- Retrieval-first (ANN) indexers -> int8 embeddings for candidate generation (saves ~30%).
- Rerank/semantic-match / production search -> fp16 embeddings.
- Hybrid: compute int8 for index, but shadow 2% of candidates with fp16 reranking to compute cosine_delta and rank drift.

lee: Any guardrails/auto-fallback rules?

ravi: Yep, minimal playbook:
- Shadowing: mirror 2% of embedding requests from int8->fp16; track avg_cosine_delta over 30m window. Alert if avg_cosine_delta > 0.012 or lang-specific delta > 0.015 (zh/code).
- Rank drift probe: hourly batch (500 queries) including zh+code; compute R@10 delta. Page if delta > 2.5pp.
- Auto-fallback: if avg_cosine_delta > 0.02 for 10m OR R@10 delta > 3pp for 5m, route 20% -> fp16 and escalate.
- Canary: run 5k simulated queries over 2h before rolling to 100%.

bench-bot: canary job queued: bench/embed-5210-canary -> 5k requests over 2h. Results will post to #eng-ml/bench-reports.

sophie: Product blurb I'll use: "Recommend int8 for candidate generation to cut embedding cost (~30%), keep fp16 for rerank/semantic-match. Require 2% shadowing, hourly retrieval probes, and auto-fallback triggers at cosine_delta/rank thresholds."

ravi: Also add one caution: "Don't use int8 for legal/compliance retrieval or PII-sensitive match tasks without fp16 verification and audit logs."

lee: Thanks 44d will paste router snippets into GTN snippets after canary results.

ravi: Will attach per-language breakdown after bench posts.
